effectsSummary: DOM 是一种迷幻剂，效果与 DOB 相似。产生视幻觉、感知改变、欣快、自我消解。持续时间长。
generalRisks: 血压危险升高。惊恐发作和心理困扰风险。过热风险。
longtermRisks: 尚无长期风险研究结果。可能发生 HPPD。
saferUse: 只使用毫克秤精確測量。
確保有 24 小時空閒時間。
[TBT] Mixed use of these potent substances should be avoided at all costs.

[TBT] As amphetamine derivatives, DOM can be particularly draining because of their long duration of action. Light vitamin-rich food, fruits, vegetable juices, vitamins and minerals promote a soft landing after the trip has subsided and can weaken a hangover.
[TBT] Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
[TBT] A trip with DOM should remain an exceptional experience. Make sure to take long breaks from consumption so that the experience can be processed.
